content: Protobuf evolution rules: never change or reuse field numbers (old binaries silently misinterpret); reserve deleted field numbers/names; proto3 preserves unknown fields since protobuf 3.5 enabling forward compatibility; unknown enum values are kept as unknown fields. sup-kv Envelope already carries proto_version and the design drops mismatched versions with a metric - correct; the residual risk is evolving the Envelope/message schemas across nodes running mixed versions during upgrade: new fields are safe (unknown to old), new semantics of old fields are not. Document upgrade policy: only additive changes within a proto_version bump.
